note: Actual normal preparation and complete no-artifact diagnostic assembly on three default repetitions of the same full real-source scan/map. The control already reuses map loading, NN reference and target normals. Both paths run actual loading, copies, native NN preparation/search, statistics, report assembly and cleanup; a saved actual ICP result is supplied at the native point-to-point solver boundary after preparation. Live solver iterations, artifact/PLY work, parity tracing/hashing/writes and CLI writes are excluded. No generated/perturbed/newly thinned coordinates, independent drive-frame or recorded SLAM telemetry claim. A traced parity pair, excluded first pair and one warm-up pair precede alternating timed pairs. All observations remain. Warmed pages; no cold-ingestion, RSS, full ICP/SLAM runtime or GPU speed claim.
